translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all twenty PDF page images. No prior English translation or translation service used. Edition glossary and primary dictionaries consulted; interpretation and uncertainties recorded per source ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p1088:b001:l001: Continues Karykan’s offer in the preceding batch; it refers to the throne.
notes.manas-2010:p1088:b001:l007: The enthronement is explicitly a deception in7–12, not sincere succession.
notes.manas-2010:p1088:b001:l012: Life-saving occasion interpreted through the warning dream immediately following; baana can also be pretext.
notes.manas-2010:p1088:b001:l014: Дубана is a wandering religious mendicant; the dream visitor is not assigned an unprinted name.
notes.manas-2010:p1088:b001:l023: Асип read as насип, allotted fortune; edition preface15 documents dropped initial n.
notes.manas-2010:p1088:b001:l024: Тараза translated Scales as the source’s stellar designation; no modern constellation identification asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1088:b001:l029: Кулач is an armspan/fathom; forty remains approximate with -тай.
notes.manas-2010:p1088:b001:l036: Алмас preserves extreme hardness/keenness as adamant, not a claim of an actual diamond lattice.
notes.manas-2010:p1089:b001:l004: Заңги rendered officer, without imposing an unverified exact rank or troop strength.
notes.manas-2010:p1089:b001:l020: Былкылдашып describes agitated movement; furtive is contextual to their plotting, not a separate printed secrecy term.
notes.manas-2010:p1089:b001:l027: Бичик written document beside oath; no invented modern contract form.
notes.manas-2010:p1089:b001:l036: Чагаан identified with чаган, spring festival/first Mongolian calendar month in the epic, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чага/. Proper festival name retained with English gloss; not a verified account of historical Chinese practice.
notes.manas-2010:p1089:b001:l038: Forty ears of the cauldron are its handles, not anatomical ears.
notes.manas-2010:p1090:b001:l002: Every animal count and repeated forty preserved; the scene is the character’s account, not ethnographic verification.
notes.manas-2010:p1090:b001:l026: The letter names the mother Altynay; the English does not invent a handwritten signature.
notes.manas-2010:p1090:b001:l032: Five Wild Sheep stars retained as the source designation; no unverified astronomical equation.
notes.manas-2010:p1090:b001:l035: Six Wild Sheep stars is a distinct repeated number and is not normalized to the earlier five.
notes.manas-2010:p1091:b001:l003: Printed mother has died retained despite her writing and being alive at1093:16; no silent harmonization to nearly dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1091:b001:l014: Sixty mothers is the visible hyperbolic wording; not silently corrected to a single mother.
notes.manas-2010:p1091:b001:l023: Таш сайынган is the established cap rank-button formula, not stone worship.
notes.manas-2010:p1091:b001:l038: Туйгун is a prized pale goshawk, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/туйгун/; the epithet is figurative.
notes.manas-2010:p1092:b001:l010: Сыр бараң rendered smooth musket provisionally; precise surface finish uncertain, not a modern rifle specification.
notes.manas-2010:p1092:b001:l011: Бөлөк read as белек, gift, contextually ironic plunder; no voluntary donation implied.
notes.manas-2010:p1092:b001:l012: Жай таш is the weather-working stone later used at1101:21; supernatural action remains literal.
notes.manas-2010:p1092:b001:l020: Armor bending is the printed motion image; no invented breaking or damage.
notes.manas-2010:p1092:b001:l022: Бут is idol in the renunciation context, not foot.
notes.manas-2010:p1092:b001:l029: Шор provisionally taken as saltwater/brine beside the travel geography; figurative misfortune remains possible in this compressed isolated row.
notes.manas-2010:p1092:b001:l041: Earth’s measuring-rope retains the miraculous shortening of distance attributed to Gabriel.
notes.manas-2010:p1093:b001:l009: Self-tethering is explicit of Sarala; no ordinary groom supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1093:b001:l021: Visible negative retained; neck stretching/turning relation to the following bow remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1093:b001:l022: No thought of conversion retained despite the previous renunciation; chronology not silently repaired.
notes.manas-2010:p1093:b001:l035: White down interpreted as bedding from37; exact pillow/spreading action in жаздады remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1093:b001:l036: Кыбыла is the direction of prayer; no mapped compass bearing added.
notes.manas-2010:p1094:b001:l003: Barefoot painful movement retained; precise force of аяндым in this dream remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1094:b001:l008: Stripped to the knees is the violent source image; material being stripped is not specified.
notes.manas-2010:p1094:b001:l021: Consuming another person’s due means appropriating what belongs to others.
notes.manas-2010:p1094:b001:l022: Аадан read as наадан, ignorant, consistent with the edition’s documented initial-n loss.
notes.manas-2010:p1095:b001:l009: The verse’s daily renewed virginity is retained as the dream’s paradise description.
notes.manas-2010:p1095:b001:l014: Printed Muslim contradicts the left-hand hell and preceding infidel at12–13. All three legible statements retained; no missing negative or changed religion invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1095:b001:l024: Жазданып literally using as a pillow retained, despite the prayer-posture context; not silently changed to spreading.
notes.manas-2010:p1095:b001:l028: Амаз = намаз, prayer; edition preface15 explicitly documents this spelling.
notes.manas-2010:p1095:b001:l040: Light is the supernatural conception image; no otherwise unidentified man named Nur invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1095:b001:l041: Орой = spirit; exact орою актан жаралган in Yudakhin means pure by birth, conventionally Muslim from birth in epic. https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lang=kg&lfrom=kg&lto=ru&word=орой. Religious implication not imposed as a separate historical claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1096:b001:l006: Айт is professing faith in the conversion context; words of a specific creed not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1096:b001:l015: Front/back cleansing with a razor is explicit; the draft does not turn this into an unprinted circumcision scene.
notes.manas-2010:p1096:b001:l031: Hair-thin bridge retained as the judgment image.
notes.manas-2010:p1096:b001:l032: Printed my people retained; referent may be the newly embraced Muslim community.
notes.manas-2010:p1097:b001:l002: Будурмак rendered rough country from terrain sense; no invented place-name. Karasayev orthographic dictionary lists будурмак тоо(будурлуу).
notes.manas-2010:p1097:b001:l007: Khangay stands for its ruler in this row, immediately identified as khan at8.
notes.manas-2010:p1097:b001:l021: Conditional follower means someone to accompany/support Almambet; no modern citizenship assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1097:b001:l037: Зубун companies/groups, edition glossary1838:b001:l005, not a guessed fixed numerical unit.
notes.manas-2010:p1098:b001:l010: Visible наадандыгын rendered foolishness. Possessive appears third-person despite praise of Mazhik nearby; not emended to honor or loyalty.
notes.manas-2010:p1098:b001:l014: Black donkey in the afterlife is the stated threat; supernatural transformation not softened into mere service.
notes.manas-2010:p1098:b001:l024: Кембайлаган denotes guarding/confinement. The printed dative Chinese has compressed case syntax; interpreted as the people keeping Mazhik under guard.
notes.manas-2010:p1098:b001:l025: Кешиги жок = unfortunate/wretched, not merciless. 2015 phraseological/defining dictionaries https://el-sozduk.kg/КЕШИГИ%20ЖОК/.
notes.manas-2010:p1098:b001:l028: Pure by birth formula, as1095:41; same primary dictionary evidence.
notes.manas-2010:p1098:b001:l035: Сайгактап denotes cattle bolting/stampeding; no unprinted specific cause added.
notes.manas-2010:p1098:b001:l042: Saddle as pillow is literal; no bed invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1099:b001:l004: Баржакта- of a plump person means jovial/carefree, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/баржакта/. Not merely broad-faced.
notes.manas-2010:p1099:b001:l011: Black Kalmyk is Almambet’s hostile characterization before recognition; religious and ethnic slurs throughout remain character speech.
notes.manas-2010:p1099:b001:l021: Melting bones is the emotional relief image; no literal injury implied.
notes.manas-2010:p1099:b001:l027: Pure by birth formula again, now addressing Almambet; exact Yudakhin evidence at1095:41.
notes.manas-2010:p1099:b001:l040: Бада is cattle herd, contextually the cattle-tending group from which companions are gathered; not a separate named community.
notes.manas-2010:p1100:b001:l004: Таптап бой кылдым provisionally trained to bodily/full strength; exact force of бой in the martial preparation is uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1100:b001:l018: Жаң-Жуң is general’s title; Ай retained as Ay. Exact historical officeholder unidentified.
notes.manas-2010:p1100:b001:l021: It-Ölbös retained as the named ridge, without geographical identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1100:b001:l027: Karabayyr retained as the horse-breed/type designation; казанат rendered battle steed.
notes.manas-2010:p1100:b001:l029: Successive animal and metal images29–39 describe horses; the startling compound images are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1100:b001:l031: Mountain roe image describes a mount, not a claim that the companion is literally riding a deer.
notes.manas-2010:p1100:b001:l041: Кыначудан provisionally read from кына-, fit closely/join, as mounts fitted for weapons/battle. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кына/ establishes the root but not this exact horse formula. No invented invulnerability or resistance to a sword blow asserted; exact construction needs specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p1101:b001:l003: Кош бадана protective mail, edition glossary1839:b001:l026; lark-eye rings retained as construction image.
notes.manas-2010:p1101:b001:l008: Hungry steel is a weapon epithet; exact sword type not specified.
notes.manas-2010:p1101:b001:l023: Суф is the breath-sound used in weather-working context, rendered breath-blown charm; no invented full verbal incantation.
notes.manas-2010:p1101:b001:l026: Three cries, three blows of breath and three whistles at27 each retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1101:b001:l035: Pines, mountains and cliffs flying are the spell’s literal epic effects.
notes.manas-2010:p1102:b001:l005: Girl comparison remains the character’s gendered insult.
notes.manas-2010:p1102:b001:l010: Кызыталак rendered daughter-selling as an insult, not an independently established transaction.
notes.manas-2010:p1102:b001:l022: Smelling against the mother’s breast is the stated leave-taking gesture.
notes.manas-2010:p1102:b001:l026: Бейпай = trouble/distress; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бейпай/ supplies the exact falling-into-trouble construction.
notes.manas-2010:p1102:b001:l030: Chest and upright burial at33 retained as Altynay’s fear; no claim that this represents actual Chinese burial customs.
notes.manas-2010:p1102:b001:l036: Questioners are the after-death interrogators in her account; no unprinted angel names supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1102:b001:l041: Көк булуң provisionally blue bend; a place-name Kök Bulung is also possible, without fixed modern identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1103:b001:l002: Sarala comparison retained beside the bay mare; no silent replacement of the visible horse designation.
notes.manas-2010:p1103:b001:l005: Mother understood as recipient of protective garment from the adjoining mounting verse.
notes.manas-2010:p1103:b001:l019: Ике read as нике, marriage, consistent with documented initial-n loss; the requested Muslim marriage solemnization is retained even though she is already called his wife.
notes.manas-2010:p1103:b001:l029: Head cut off and tied to the body of its bearer is the explicit instruction; no missing passage supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1103:b001:l036: Саринжи identified with сарынжы, outer coat: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/сарынжы/ and Atabekov edition glossary https://manas-discovery.kg/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/К.АТАБЕКОВ_оонч.вариант.pdf describe the garment. No named armor or invulnerability invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1104:b001:l013: Nails/hair and stroking forehead kept as the father’s affectionate gesture.
notes.manas-2010:p1104:b001:l018: Келем шариф names the holy Quran, not Almighty God; edition and established project correction.
notes.manas-2010:p1104:b001:l041: Stabbed gland is the literal pain simile; not modern medical evidence.
notes.manas-2010:p1105:b001:l014: Hair girdle and circumcision at age three are the father’s hostile caricature, not an ethnographic assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1105:b001:l016: Бүтүн жерин literally intact part, euphemistically private parts cut; no full genital removal specified.
notes.manas-2010:p1105:b001:l024: Алты сан six great hosts retained without turning сан into a fixed numerical count.
notes.manas-2010:p1105:b001:l026: Negative ашпагын and баспагын at27 retained: do not cross/do not tread.
notes.manas-2010:p1106:b001:l007: Visible астыңдан is beneath you, addressing the father; exact relation of idol/father in this challenge remains awkward and is not normalized.
notes.manas-2010:p1106:b001:l013: Path not going is the source’s hesitation image beside inability to strike his father.
notes.manas-2010:p1106:b001:l020: Cow-rump is the horse’s conformation comparison, not a different animal.
notes.manas-2010:p1106:b001:l029: Жеңи visibly sleeves, not knees. Gesture likely refusal to prostrate, but the draft retains the garment wording.
notes.manas-2010:p1106:b001:l034: Бүрүк uncircumcised, edition1836:b001:l002; the surrounding disparagement is the mother’s speech.
notes.manas-2010:p1106:b001:l037: Тунугум pure/clear one, not тунгуч firstborn; affectionate body-image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1106:b001:l038: Тунжур female goshawk and туйгун prized pale goshawk, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/ТУНЖУР/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/туйгун/. Comparison rendered without an invented great-hawk species.
notes.manas-2010:p1107:b001:l003: Exact maternal curse: refusing forgiveness for breast milk given, Yudakhin https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lfrom=kg&word=АК; not literally making milk white.
notes.manas-2010:p1107:b001:l008: Seven Stars retained as the stellar designation in a nursing-time formula.
notes.manas-2010:p1107:b001:l015: Алакан is the leather flap of the whip, not a black human palm.
notes.manas-2010:p1107:b001:l030: Narrative repetition acknowledged by the speaker; not omitted as redundant.
notes.manas-2010:p1107:b001:l034: Same bronze idol reappears after being smashed; visible repetition retained without inventing repair or replacement.
notes.manas-2010:p1107:b001:l042: Final object phrase continues into1108; no action added to complete the sentence.

transcription_check.scope: All twenty PDF page images individually visually inspected.840 verse display rows, no headings/prose/apparatus. Raw unchanged; no manuscript collation.

alignment_check.method: All840 ordered Kyrgyz/draft pairs read in three280-row groups with complete output. Material corrections reread at source positions. Same-agent review only; no independent specialist review.
